purpose: Teach: 悗/薀/ワット/塁/モル/代打/士官/コミンテルン

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、漢字の悗、つまり「悗」の古典用法の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, your paper explored the classical usage of the character 悗, didn't it?
lines.style: Warm, genuinely curious. Slight upward lilt at the end—not interrogating, inviting confirmation. Steady eye contact, the tone of a teacher who has actually read the work.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、薀蓄、つまり薀の語源研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I researched the etymology of 薀—the concept of accumulated knowledge—in my paper.
lines.style: Clear, direct, focused. A beat of quiet pride beneath the surface. Speaks with the precision of someone who has thought deeply about her subject. No overselling.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 電力単位のワットの歴史研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Your exploration of the historical development of the watt—the electrical unit—was quite thorough.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost musing. Measured pace. A slight nod built into the delivery, affirming without fussing. The tone of someone turning an idea over in their mind.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、野球の塁、つまり塁間の戦術研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I examined the tactical geometry of baseball bases—the spacing and positioning strategies—in my research.
lines.style: Composed, precise. Speaks with the quiet confidence of someone explaining something they understand completely. Even tempo, no filler.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 化学のモル、つまりモル数の概念研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Your paper on the conceptual foundations of the mole in chemistry was particularly insightful.
lines.style: Measured, reflective. A soft settling into the thought. Speaks as though to herself first, then to Sakura. Gentle affirmation without performative praise.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、野球の代打、つまり代打起用の統計研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I looked at the statistical patterns of pinch-hitter deployment across different game situations.
lines.style: Steady, assured. The voice of someone presenting findings she stands behind. Slight emphasis on the analytical rigor. Not defensive—just matter-of-fact about the work's value.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 明治期の士官、つまり将校制度の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And your research into the Meiji-period officer corps—the structure of the military hierarchy—was quite original.
lines.style: Calm, genuinely impressed. A longer contemplative pause mid-sentence. Speaks with the weight of someone recognizing real scholarly effort. Warm closure.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、戦間期のコミンテルン、つまり共産主義インターの研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I studied the Comintern's role during the interwar period, the networks and ideology of international communism.
lines.style: Focused, direct, finishing strong. A note of intellectual conviction underneath. The pace quickens slightly as she articulates the scope of her work. Confident close.
